scope: Closed cumulative effective primary DXF decoder/transport identity and exact-input compatibility admission. Replace overlapping-counter inference; no new CLI option, raw ISO producer admission or native/DWG qualification.

contract.facts: One profile for each completed semantic decode; fixed sourceProfileCalls/sourceProfileMask and noexcept profileCount query append to existing observation fields. Counts partition calls, not unique records/characters or source coverage. Other counters overlap.
contract.effectiveIdentity: Reader classifies immediately after completed primary conversion, using actual converter kind, exact selected decoder and recovery flags; not the requested or final normalized HEADER. Metadata/raw controls/handles/binary roles remain excluded.
contract.ascii: Empty values and represented ASCII escape transport are decoder-independent. Nonempty UTF16/TU-style input is distinct even when every raw byte is below0x80. Nested MIF/escape semantics remain separately constrained by existing decode issues.
contract.lifecycle: Owned cumulative facts survive later HEADER/version/page changes, copied outcomes, returned/throwing failures and reader destruction. Existing snapshot/reuse/writes/rejected-operation tests now compare new profile fields too.
contract.admission: For explicit ExactNamed, checked sum/mask reconstruction must equal semanticDecodeCalls/sourceProfileMask; overflow, saturation, missing NoProfile identity or inconsistency is EvidenceUnavailable. Only explicitly enumerated17 existing compatibility profiles are eligible. ISO4/non-modern UTF8/UTF16/unavailable/unidentified profiles cannot gain eligibility from a later canonical/modern HEADER.
contract.claimBoundary: Eligibility is compatibility conversion policy, not normative AutoCAD producer conformance, exhaustive charset qualification, native rendering or whole-document completeness. Raw ISO4 producer profile remains separate and unqualified.
contract.defaults: Compatible source admission/output and DXF decode strings are unchanged. No CLI option/default, pure callback, DWG byte-layout or output-policy change.
contract.publicLayout: Fixed observation layout grows; downstream rebuild required, no binary ABI or concurrency guarantee.

tests.canonicalMatrix: 14 independently anchored Windows pages × ASCII/binary AC1015 input; literal Unicode, physical declaration, exact effective profile and closed admission asserted.
tests.exportMatrix: Windows932/1252 × ASCII/binary × AC1018/AC1021 target, two exports plus third read, literal TEXT and distinct nonzero-Z LINE.
tests.mixedScope: Old exact/nonASCII counters are both positive for legacy ASCII followed by modern UTF8 and for earlier ISO bytes followed by modern UTF8. New facts admit only the decoder-independent case and retain ISO in the other.
evidenceMutationScope: NoProfile missing identity with otherwise matching total
additionalControls: UTF16 ASCII bytes versus ASCII wire transport
invalid profile enum sanitized to missing evidence and safe mask/query behavior
actual unavailable high-byte profile versus ASCII independent escapes

selectedGate.scope: Rebuilt selected reader/header/CLI/codec/hardening/diagnostic/fixture gate, not the full suite.

asanUbsan.rebuild: Changed public header propagated through all core instrumented TUs and adapter/test target.

frozenCompatibility.scope: Fresh current-source probe compilation/run; not unchanged old executable reuse.

baselineScope: No old executable was run with the new profile mode. The old coarse predicate is source-inspected; current authored mixed controls explicitly assert both old counters positive and distinguish the required per-consumption outcomes. Do not label this a frozen-parent runtime reproduction.

primarySources.use: Release-specific string storage distinguishes modern UTF8 and legacy ASCII/CIF; the explicit Windows compatibility set is not claimed normative producer qualification.
Control/caret interpretation remains separate from scalar/profile facts; no command escaping change is made.

limits: Profile IDs are observation identities, not DWG numeric codepage IDs.
Raw carrier coverage and unknown/unsupported entity completeness are not inferred from profile counts.
Malformed/undefined/unrepresented text still uses existing issues; an eligible profile does not erase them.
No independent CAD producer/native reader was run for the new authored inputs. Canonical mapping anchors are selected literal field controls, not exhaustive per-page byte qualification.
SourceProfileCount is fixed/bounded; it does not change logical retained-string budget scope to whole-model/RSS accounting.

next.action: Exact complete-token CLI option wiring and actual positional/FreeCAD/batch conversions under the closed compatibility contract; retain default Compatible and explicit unsupported-profile/refusal behavior for raw ISO4. Profile evidence alone does not promote support.

notRun: New native FreeCAD/LibreCAD/LC3 or installed-consumer/package qualification
fixturePolicy: Only locally authored scratch DXF input at test runtime; no downloaded/committed drawing fixture, dependency or new CTest registration. User-owned untracked files preserved.
